title: 2023-2024 Panini NBA Hoops Scoot Henderson RC #232 Portland Trail Blazers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Capture a piece of basketball history with the 2023-2024 Panini NBA Hoops Scoot Henderson RC #232 card, showcasing the promising talent of Scoot Henderson with the Portland Trail Blazers. This rookie card, number 232 from the set, is a must-have for collectors and fans alike, representing a fresh chapter in the sport's storied legacy.

Crafted with the quality Panini is known for, this card is part of the base variety from the 2023-24 season, highlighting the National Basketball Association's exciting craftsmanship. Whether you're a fan of the player, the team, or the game itself, this sports trading card is an exceptional addition to any collection.
